_comment_builder: Set builder_script to use a custom builder (e.g. 'my_domain/builder.py:MyBuilder'). Leave null for default AILS builder.
_comment_evaluator: Set evaluator_script to use a custom evaluator. Leave null for default AILS evaluator.
_comment_ails: Path to the AILS folder (contains AILSII.jar, data/, warm_start/). Use absolute path or path relative to where you run evo_agent.py from.
